stories.title: Token Revocation API
stories.description: Implement an API endpoint to explicitly revoke bearer tokens by token_id, setting revoked_at and ensuring immediate invalidation across all authentication checks.

stories.title: Auth Middleware Enforcement for Lifecycle Rules
stories.description: Enhance bearer token validation middleware to enforce expiration, revocation, and rotation rules at request time, including rejection of expired, revoked, or superseded tokens.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Unit & Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering token issuance, rotation, expiration, revocation, and invalid token scenarios, including edge cases such as reuse of rotated tokens.

stories.title: GPTReader Integration with Token Lifecycle Store
stories.description: Integrate GPTReader request handling with the token lifecycle management system, ensuring all read operations validate tokens against the new schema and lifecycle rules before executing queries.
